تشترعين (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرِعِينَ (taštariʕīna) /taʃ.ta.ri.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# تُشْتَرَعِينَ (tuštaraʕīna) /tuʃ.ta.ra.ʕiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
